title: Model and context controls
codexDefault: Codex login default (record actual model after request)
codexDefaultUnknown: Login default; actual ID confirmed by request
nextTurn: Generating: changes apply to the next turn
fetchCodexHelp: Read the Codex catalog to select exact IDs and supported effort levels.
effortUnknown: Effort levels are unverified; only model defaults are available.
budgetHelp: Model capacity, user budget and estimated request size are different values. A budget cannot expand model capacity.
reserveHelp: These are local capacity reserves, not guaranteed output or reasoning tokens. Conservative UTF-8 estimates are used without an official tokenizer.
precedence: Precedence: request → session → feature → project → global → model defaults. Queued requests use immutable snapshots.
historyHelp: Original history is retained. Exclusions affect future requests only. Native thread IDs, internal tool states and hidden reasoning are never transferred between providers.
summaryHelp: A summary is editable discussion data, never Canon. Sources and versions are retained; original messages remain intact.
featurePreviewBoundary: This entry retains its existing source selector and context preview. These controls set the model, parameters and overall budget; no unbuilt request is fabricated.
estimate: Conservative estimate, not billing token count
previewBoundary: This shows application-managed request material, not credentials, hidden safety instructions, hidden reasoning or provider-internal additions.
parameterHelp: Only verified supported parameters are sent. Unknown, ineffective or conflicting settings block the request explicitly, with no silent fallback.
codexParameterUnavailable: This generation control is not exposed by the current Codex SDK.
capabilityUnknown: Unsupported or unknown. Verify capabilities in AI provider settings first.
stopSequences: Stop sequences (separated by a vertical bar)
costHelp: Requires configured prices and a supported output limit. Local estimates do not replace provider billing or official spending limits.
retryHelp: No automatic paid generation retries, continuation or cross-provider fallback. You decide the next step after failure or cancellation.
catalogHelp: Catalog discovery is not an entitlement check. A successful request verifies access for that request. Codex login and API key access are independent.
prices: Reference price per million input / output tokens
manualModelHelp: Add, edit or remove API models under Settings → AI providers, even without a model-list endpoint. Gemini / Claude currently use configured OpenAI-compatible protocols; unimplemented native fields are never sent.
presetHelp: Save the current model, effective parameters and context policy as an editable preset. Stale pinned sources must be reselected for another project.
localPreferences: Preferences are stored in the user data directory, without API keys.
staleResult: Inputs changed during generation. This result may be stale and did not overwrite new edits.
parallelEditing: AI is responding. You can keep editing; new changes apply to the next turn.
levelsWarning: Enter only levels verified by official metadata, docs or actual tests. Manual overrides do not establish provider support.
assistantPreviewInstruction: Preview authorized assistant context without executing actions.
maxTurns: Maximum model rounds for this request
assistantStreamBoundary: Tool planning retains the existing non-streaming request mode. More rounds never expand Action permissions.
saveScope: Save as a different scope default
previewStale: Settings or sources changed. The previous preview remains visible; rebuild before sending.
saveMemory: Save as discussion memory candidate (not Canon)
waitOrStop: A request is still generating. Keep editing, then wait for completion or explicitly stop it before sending.
catalogLoaded: Codex catalog loaded. Choose an exact model; a catalog is not an access guarantee.
selectCodexHelp: Choose an exact Codex model to adjust its confirmed reasoning levels.
waitForControls: Loading this turn’s model and parameters. You can send when ready.
loginModelUnknown: Current Codex login default (exact model not confirmed)
codexLoginDestination: Existing Codex login; credentials are never shown
preflightInvalidEffort: This effort is not supported by the selected model
preflightCallerScope: Authorized sources supplied by this feature; review its source preview
preflightSavedChapter: Current saved manuscript and selected references
preflightMissingModel: This model is not in the current catalog. Select another model or refresh it.
preflightStale: The manuscript or source scope changed. Refresh it before execution.
preflightApproved: Author-approved scope; checked again before execution.
preflightNeedsApproval: Review and approve source scope through this task’s permission flow.
preflightPendingOnly: This preview sends no content and calls no model. Execution receipts show actual model, usage and parameters; existing cost approval remains in force.
preflightParameters: Request overrides (unset values retain model defaults)
